jobs.description:
is the localization engineering platform. Teams measure translation quality, translate with LLMs, and proofread with native speakers. We are a small YC-backed team, fully remote, with paying customers.

This is our first marketing hire. You own content end to end: creation, publishing, distribution, measurement, and automation.

Apply through our careers page, not through this listing:

What you own

Blog posts, research articles, essays, changelogs, the newsletter. Distribution on LinkedIn, dev.to, Hacker News and Reddit. Interviewing our engineers and customers, then writing for both technical and non-technical readers. Weekly publishing, with volume growing through Claude workflows and templated distribution. SEO, GEO and AI search visibility, measured in Ahrefs, Search Console and the ad accounts. The outcomes: signups, citations, rankings, backlinks.

What we look for

Distribution results you can point at. A site you grew, a page that outranked an incumbent, a property that gets cited by AI assistants at volume. You write plainly, with no superlatives and no sentences that carry nothing. You code enough to automate your own workflow and distribution. You interview well and get people on the record saying something quotable. You use Claude daily as a production method and have opinions about prompting and output quality. You understand what Hacker News, the LinkedIn algorithm and AI systems reward. You work from Ahrefs and Search Console data.

Do not apply if

You do not use Claude daily. You plan work from keyword spreadsheets. Your job ends at publishing. You need a weekly brief. You call yourself non-technical. Your portfolio is generic. You want to manage a team right away.

What you get

Original engineering research to write about. The whole pipeline, from draft to measured impact. Claude Code and Claude Cowork budget for volume production. Small team, direct founder access. Conference and learning budget, flexible hours, health insurance.

Hiring process

Screening call with Max, our CEO. Trial project plus an interview. Offer. Four-week probation period. You hear back within a few days at every step.

How to apply

Apply on our careers page: The form there asks a few opinion questions instead of a CV. That form is the only application we review.

jobs.description:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace—so teams can ship faster with confidence.

We’re a Series C company backed by top-tier investors,with over $135M in funding and a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Team

Our engineering team builds systems that interact with some of the most complex software ever deployed in production. The team is composed of industry veterans that have built deep learning infrastructure, autonomous drones, ridesharing marketplaces, ad tech and much more. We are looking for an AI Sales Engineer (Solutions Architect) to join the good fight and get this product in the hands of every AI/ML organization.

You'll work side-by-side with our Account Executives to articulate the Arize value and overall strategy to differentiate the platform throughout the sales process and drive POCs from requirements gathering to close. The activities performed by an AI Sales Engineer are diverse - one day you might be assisting with a high-level pitch of Arize to a CDO, and the next day you might be working hands-on to develop a small proof of concept.

What You’ll Do

You are the trusted advisor to the customer:

  • Partner with our account executives to articulate the overall Arize value proposition, vision, and strategy to customers
  • Work closely with some of the most sophisticated GenAI teams in the world.
    • You will act as a trusted advisor to our prospective customers, while also building relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Lead product demonstrations of the Arize platform
    • Advise on GenAI and ML best practices
  • Lead discovery to understand prospect’s GenAI tech stack to collaborate with the Sales team to construct a compelling value proposition of the Arize Platform
  • Lead Proof of Concept (PoC) motions with prospective buyers
  • Handle technical objections and develop strategies across sales, engineering, and product to unblock them

What We’re Looking For

Note: Even if you do not check every single box, we still encourage you to apply!

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as sales engineer, solutions engineer, or forward deployed engineer
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to simplify complex, technical concepts
  • Proficiency in Python / Typescript
  • Knowledge of LLM / Agentic frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, and DSPy
  • Understanding of GenAI concepts and application evaluation + development lifecycle
  • A quick and self learner - undaunted by technical complexity of production AI deployments and welcome the challenge to learn about them and develop your own POV.

Bonus Points, But Not Required

  • Previous experience working across and aligning Sales, Product, and Engineering
  • Previous experience within a team that underwent a high growth stage
  • Previous engineering experience in: Data Engineering, MLOps, Kubernetes, GCP / AWS / Azure

Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup
